title: UNDER DASH BRACE RODS
summary: Convertible (19467) under-dash brace rods: the steering column support braces that tie the steering column bracket support to the hinge pillar gusset / lower windshield frame reinforcement and to the cowl (brackets spotwelded to the windshield frame), plus the cross brace at the steering bracket support. Rod ends are held with screws and nuts (15-22 lb-ft) and a bolt, washers and nuts (20-30 lb-ft).
